select.name: Select
select.prompt: Click to select · Shift-click adds or removes · drag left→right for items fully inside, right→left for anything touched · drag a selected item to move it (Alt: copy) · Delete removes.
select.promptPoints: Drag points or handles · double-click a point: smooth ↔ corner · double-click the outline: add a point · click a point, then Delete: remove it · Esc deselects.

line.name: Line
line.promptFirst: Click or type the first point.
line.promptNext: Click the next point, or type length and angle. Shift locks to 15°.
line.promptMore: Next point · click the first point to close · Enter, double-click or right-click to finish · Backspace undoes a point.

rectangle.name: Rectangle
rectangle.promptFirst: Click or type the first corner. Hold Alt to draw from the centre.
rectangle.promptCorner: Click the opposite corner, or type width and height.
rectangle.promptCentre: From centre: click a corner, or type the full width and height.

circle.name: Circle
circle.promptRadius: Click a point on the circle, or type the radius.
circle.promptP1: Click the first point on the circle.
circle.promptAxis: Click the end of the first axis (sets its radius and direction).
circle.promptOther: Click to set the other radius, or type it.

fillet.name: Fillet
fillet.promptPick: Hover a corner between two straight edges. Shift: every corner of that shape.
fillet.promptApply: Click to round this corner (Shift: all corners). Type a radius to change it.
fillet.tooLarge: Too large for this corner: the largest radius that fits is {max} mm.

stitchHoles.name: Stitch holes
stitchHoles.promptPick: Hover a stitch line (or any line) to preview its holes.
stitchHoles.promptClick: Click to add these holes. They stay linked to the line and follow it.

common.layerUnavailable: The active layer is locked or hidden. Unlock or show it, or pick another layer in the Layers panel.
common.joinNone: Select open paths to join (or one whose ends meet, to close it).
common.booleanNone: Select two or more closed shapes (outlines or circles).

transform.promptPick: Select objects (click, Shift-click, or drag a box), then press Enter or right-click.

move.name: Move
move.promptBase: Click or type the base point.
move.promptTarget: Click the destination, or type ΔX and ΔY. Shift locks to 15°.

rotate.name: Rotate
rotate.promptCentre: Click or type the centre of rotation.
rotate.promptAngle: Click to set the angle (from the +X direction), or type it. Shift rounds to 15°.

scale.name: Scale
scale.promptBase: Click or type the base point (it stays fixed).
scale.promptRef: Type a factor, or click a reference point.
scale.promptTarget: Click where the reference point should go, or type a factor.

mirror.name: Mirror
mirror.promptFirst: Click a centre line to mirror across it, or click the first point of the axis.
mirror.promptSecond: Click the second axis point, or type the axis angle. Shift locks to 15°.

offset.name: Offset
offset.promptPick: Click a path, circle or centre line to offset.
offset.promptSide: Click the side to offset to (distance follows the cursor, or type it). Click again for another; Esc picks another source.
offset.promptApprox: Offset made. Some curves were offset as fine polylines to stay within 0.02 mm. Click again for another offset.

stitchLine.name: Stitch line
stitchLine.promptPick: Click an outline to add a stitch line to.
stitchLine.promptSide: Click inside or outside for the side (margin from project settings, or type it). The line stays linked to the outline.
stitchLine.promptApprox: Stitch line added; some curves are fine polylines to stay within 0.02 mm. Click the next outline.

chamfer.name: Chamfer
chamfer.promptPick: Hover a corner between two straight edges. Shift: every corner of that shape.
chamfer.promptApply: Click to cut this corner (Shift: all corners). Type distances, or a distance and an angle.
chamfer.tooLarge: Too large for this corner: at most {max} mm along each edge.
chamfer.notApplicable: Can’t cut this corner at that angle.

pen.name: Pen (curves)
pen.promptFirst: Click for a corner, drag for a smooth curve point.
pen.promptNext: Click for a corner, drag for a curve. Type length and angle for a straight edge. Shift locks to 15°.
pen.promptMore: Click the first point to close · Enter, double-click or right-click to finish · Backspace removes the last point.

arc.name: Arc (3 points)
arc.promptStart: Click or type the start of the arc.
arc.promptEnd: Click or type the end of the arc.
arc.promptThrough: Click a point the arc passes through.
arc.collinear: The three points are on a line: pick a point off it.

centreLine.name: Centre line
centreLine.promptShape: Click a shape to add a centre line through its middle. Mirror can use it as an axis.
centreLine.promptFirst: Click or type the first point.
centreLine.promptSecond: Click the second point. Shift locks to 15°.

label.name: Label
label.promptPlace: Click or type where the text starts (left end of its baseline). Labels go on the Notes layer.
label.promptText: Type the text, e.g. piece name and "cut 2", then press Enter. Click elsewhere to move it · Esc cancels.
label.promptGrainStart: Click or type one end of the grain arrow.
label.promptGrainEnd: Click the other end, or type length and angle. Shift locks to 15°.

parallel.name: Parallel line
parallel.promptPlace: Click on the side and at the distance wanted, or type the distance (the cursor picks the side). Esc picks another edge.

trim.name: Trim / extend / split
trim.promptTrim: Click the piece of a line to remove: it is cut back to the nearest crossings. Shift-click extends instead.
trim.promptExtend: Click near the end of a line to extend it to the next line it meets. Shift-click trims instead.
trim.promptSplit: Click a line or outline to split it at that point.

perpendicular.name: Perpendicular
perpendicular.promptPlace: Click to place a perpendicular line, or type how far along the edge and how long. Esc picks another edge.

measure.name: Measure
measure.promptDistance: Click two points to measure the distance.
measure.promptAngle: Click a point, the corner, then another point.
measure.promptLength: Hover a shape to see its length.
